text:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding hit from a user trying to enable the structured-output adapter in the sample app. They flipped SDK `jsonMode: true` + our schema adapter and the function-calling response is getting wrapped in an array, then the SDK schema helper errors out.

sasha: ugh, seen this before? any repro steps?

alex: repro in 3 lines:
```bash
# minimal repro (node):
npm i @redwood/sdk-sample
node ./examples/structured-adapter-repro.js
```
and config is basically:
```js
redwood.init({
  jsonMode: true,
  fnCallAdapter: 'schema-chef',
  retry: { enabled: true, strategy: 'auth-refresh' }
})
```
log: 
```
ERROR schema-chef: expected object, got array
  at parseResponse (schema-chef/index.js:45)
  at handleFnCall (sdk/runtime.js:312)
```

devon: hmm — could be two distinct issues that interact: the auth-retry wrapper reserializes the body (we do a JSON.stringify on retry) and the schema adapter expects a raw parsed object. If retry double-encoded it becomes a stringified array which our parser then wraps?

maya: quick workaround for the sample app: set `retry.enabled=false` or set `jsonMode:false` and use the structured parser manually: `structuredParser.parse(res.body)` — not ideal for users though.

alex: the odd part is node vs py parity: the Python SDK's adapter accepted the array (coerced to the first element) while node blew up. So parity bug + retry double-encode = onboarding friction.

sasha: can you capture a raw request/response pair? maybe post the full wire body (sanitized). we should know if the array is arriving from the model or introduced by the client.

alex: posted sanitized payload in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-repro/abcd1234 — model returned: `[{"tool":"get_user","args":{"id":123}}]` (array-of-objects). Python helper did `coerce_to_object(items[0])`. Node helper enforces `type === 'object'` and errors.

devon: ok that explains it. Two actionable fixes: (1) make schema-chef accept array by coercing single-element arrays to object (2) fix retry layer to avoid double-stringify on auth refresh. I'll open 2 PRs.

maya: can you add a small integration test to sample app that runs with `jsonMode:true` + `fnCallAdapter:schema-chef` so we don't regress? put test under `examples/structured-adapter/test/repro.spec.js` — include both node and python smoke harnesses if possible.

alex: filing issue now with repro steps and suggested patch. Issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SDK-1127 — added labels: devex, parity, oncall.

ci-bot: Build queued for branch alex/sdk-1127-parity-fix — https://ci.redwood.company/12345

devon: small nit — if we coerce arrays, log a debug line and include a telemetry event `sdk.coerce.single_element_array` so we can measure how often users hit this.

alex: agreed. i'll include telemetry and a short note in the sample app README about recommended config & the temporary workaround.

sasha: thanks all. once PRs land let's push a tiny patch to the onboarding quickstart so new signups don't hit this in the wild. :thumbsup:
